_meta.description: Golden semantic-correctness entries (spec rev 5 §13): question -> metric/dimensions/expected for every currently served governed metric, plus one ad-hoc define_metric round trip. Expected values are derived by the INDEPENDENT hand-written SQL inside tests/test_evals.py at run time (the two seed-note rules spelled out inline; plain customer-count SQL) — never from the seed script, the fixture generator, or the facade. The baked 'expected' values below are cross-checked against that SQL on every run (tolerance 1e-6), so a stale golden cannot pass silently.
_meta.db: examples/retail-demo/data/demo.db (rebuilt via examples/retail-demo/seed_db.py into tmp by the test)
_meta.served_set: semantic_layer/models + context_layer are snapshotted from the repo worktree copy when present; in fresh checkouts (gitignored, absent) the test reconstructs the served set from the recorded rev-4 golden orders model (tests/test_serve.py GOLDEN_OSI) plus the verbatim promoted customers model embedded in tests/test_evals.py — workaround recorded in the lane report.
rules_applied: Exclude orders with status CANCELLED or RETURNED.
Pre-2024 EMEA rows are stored in local currency without conversion: multiply amount and product_cost by currency_conversion_rate.rate_to_usd for the row's currency; all other rows are already USD.
gross_margin = (gross_revenue - cogs) / gross_revenue per region (ratio of sums).
customer_count = COUNT(*) over the customers master data (no status/time rules).
_meta.adhoc_entries: Entries with "adhoc": true route through define_metric (governed false); their 'expected' is null because the full per-customer expectation is derived at run time by independent SQL and compared row by row. The ad-hoc mean (spec 2026-09-23-0003 rev 2) is the AVG of billable order amounts in USD per customer_id: CANCELLED/RETURNED excluded, pre-2024 EMEA amounts converted via currency_conversion_rate.rate_to_usd, other amounts already USD.
